sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You are hard working by nature but get highly frustrated when things do not end the way you had imagined, feels Ganesha. This may lead to anger against the system or the order in which things work. You will vent your frustration on your routine by longing for an alternate lifestyle, wishing and hoping for more relaxation and perhaps a spontaneous vacation.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: You're generally focused on the material world, Taurus, but something about the energy generated by today's planetary alignments causes you to look within. You might think about the joys and pains of past family gatherings and wonder how they affect your life now. This is a positive, healing process, so don't fight it. It won't interfere with what's going on around you.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: You're in the midst of closing major life chapters, and will need to establish solid foundations before you feel confident enough to rebuild. As Luna forms supportive aspects with Neptune, Pluto, and Uranus, focus on what brings you comfort and security. Aim to improve your health by committing to a consistent wellness practice, embracing small changes you can gradually build upon. It may be necessary to step away from situations that threaten to send you backward, but cutting ties is part of life's journey.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Today you might have to face several tensions and difference of opinion that will make you feel irritated and uneasy. If you are traveling, then take special care of your valuables. Acting carelessly can increase the chances of theft or misplacing your items. Your stubborn behaviour offends those at home and even your close friends. Personal affairs will be under control. Do not feel shy when asked for your opinion-as you will be highly appreciated for it. Today, you will have a very close communication about each other's beautiful feelings for each other. It is a good day for you.

readings.text: You will understand today that hard work always pays off. You will give your best today. You may not remain flexible. You will see the results of the efforts you take. You will succeed on the career front as opportunities will knock at your door.

You will feel indecisive, and this will make you irritable since you would rather make a decision than sit in limbo. Resist the temptation to act without thinking first. It is fine to spend time in deliberation. It will behoove you to do so.

bits.t: You are hard working by nature but get highly frustrated when things do not end the way you had imagined, feels Ganesha.
This may lead to anger against the system or the order in which things work.

readings.text: Ganesha feels that the day is going to be excellent for laying foundation of long term financial future. today you will be able to get good business or work for the organization.

You have a time of communication in order to exchange ideas. This can be very conducive to starting a new career or advancing in the one you have. All that's required is to be true to yourself. Aspects affecting communication make you a little quirky and unique. You don't care what others think, which makes it so much easier for you to ask for what you're worth.

Today you will remain in good health. Your mood will also not swing much. You will be able to stay focussed on everything that you need to address. Towards second half of the day, you are likely to feel more emotional.

Today's planetary energy assists you in exploratory thinking. The ability to recall early experiences or to examine body issues is enhanced by your critical thinking capacity. This aspect enhances our deepest emotions and registers every compliment and insult. Therefore, use this aspect to heighten your awareness of your body. A challenging yoga session will focus your mind and create space for new awareness to emerge. Don't push yourself but stay on top of this exercise.

extras.text: Your energy is beginning to lag -- a late afternoon walk will give you a boost.
